summary: Orla Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, furnishing its Notice of Annual General and Special Meeting and Management Information Circular for a meeting scheduled June 16, 2026. The agenda includes receiving audited financial statements, electing directors, appointing Deloitte LLP as auditor, and a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation. This is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. No deal terms or corporate action beyond standard annual governance is disclosed.
